source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Open with the actor saying:
"Someone sent me a message." (The actor begins reading the message from the phone.)
"I keep losing all the time. It feels like something is wrong with the game." — Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a!
(Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a! — translation of the message.)
The actor then replies:
"Most likely, you downloaded a fake version where it’s impossible to win!
Let me demonstrate what the fake version looks like.
We’ll play this one first.
The graphics seem strange.
There, we played and lost immediately, right?
That is the fake version.
Next, let’s open the real app.
We’ll play here for a little while.
I’ve already placed my bet at €35, okay?
Notice that the graphics are different here.
Four more steps... great.
€2,480.
I personally controlled every step.
Now let’s withdraw the money.
We’ll wait a moment for the winning confirmation to appear here.
The money is already in my account.
Look, my banking app has already sent a notification.
That’s everything.
See?
The entire process took 12 minutes.
It really is that simple.
This is why many people lose their money: they play through fake apps.
Use the link below the video to download only the official app and earn money just as I do."
